API ReferenceZIdentity APIAPI ClientsApiclient Ops Delete Secret
Apiclient Ops Delete Secret
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/api-clients/:id/secrets/:secretsId

Removes a specific secret associated with an API client using the Client ID and secret ID. After deletion, the secret cannot be recovered.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the API client.

secretsId
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the secret to be deleted.

Responses
​
204
401

The secret was successfully deleted.

No content is returned in the response, but may be useful for validation purposes.
